messages:
Ana Patel: Quick check — coordinating SDK/docs/quickstarts for the next release. Need the final changelog slice, sampleapp parity, and a clear sign-off window. Proposing changelog freeze: Thu Mar 26 23:59 PT (UTC-7). Who can commit to final reviews?

Sahil Kapoor: Ack. SDK PRs mostly green. One blocker: go-sdk build failing on musl image (CI job: ci/sdk-go-musl). Investigating now, reassigning flaky test to myself.

Megan Liu: Docs side — several async-redirect PRs still in flight. I need a streaming API sample for the quickstart. Who owns the sampleapp updates? cc @Jorge Ramirez.

Jorge Ramirez: I can own the sampleapp updates. Plan: update node + python quickstarts, add streaming demo, run local smoke. ETA Tue Mar 24 EOD PT. Need a sample token and a short prompt set from product.

devex-bot: Reminder: changelog freeze scheduled at 3619994321 (Thu Mar 26 23:59 PT). Auto-merge will be disabled 2h prior. Run /release-checklist to verify items.

Ana Patel: Two asks: (1) who will do final changelog editorial review? (2) can we get a perf matrix for SDK 1.4 (latency + token cost) before freeze — nice-to-have but helpful for release notes.

Megan Liu: I can take changelog editorial Wed morning. For perf numbers, @Sahil can you export the perf-run-102 results and paste the link here?

Sahil Kapoor: Yes. Will post perf link later today. FYI, go-sdk musl CI failing due to ldflags; quick workaround locally: `CGO_ENABLED=0` build. Will push fix in PR #3456.

Sahil Kapoor: ```bash
# local smoke
git fetch origin pull/789/head:pr-789
make smoke SAMPLE_TOKEN=redwood_local_token
```

Jorge Ramirez: Sampleapp PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapps/pull/789 — includes streaming demo + quickstart updates. @Megan please add docs snippet to /docs/quickstarts/streaming.md and reference the streaming example.

Megan Liu: Adding docs snippet now. Quick Q: should we include an `X-Request-Id` example for tracing? Product suggested we recommend it.

Ana Patel: Yes include `X-Request-Id` and a short note about idempotent retries and backoff. Also ensure changelog entry mentions: "streaming: added server-side backpressure example".

Samir Khan: Telemetry team here — we'll run the smoke telemetry checks against the RC automatically and surface any regressions. If you need extra metrics, ping me. Also request: increase `smoke/test-release` log retention to 48h for postmortem.

Megan Liu: Noted. Also a doc lint flag popped for code fence language on the streaming sample — I'll fix after I paste the snippet.

Sahil Kapoor: Perf link: https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/102 — shows 95th latency delta <6% vs previous. Pushed go-sdk fix in #3456, CI rerun queued.

Jorge Ramirez: After Megan's docs patch I'll run the sampleapp CI (`ci/sampleapps-smoke`) and report results here. If green, I'll request a reviewer from devex for final sign-off.

Ana Patel: Sounds good. Final logistics: changelog editorial done Wed AM by Megan, sampleapps by Jorge Tue EOD, SDK fix by Sahil today. Locking changelog freeze at Thu Mar 26 23:59 PT. If you need an exception, flag it by Wed Mar 25 18:00 PT with explicit reason and owner. :lock:

Megan Liu: :thumbsup: will update PRs and post a changelog draft by Wed 09:00 PT.

Sahil Kapoor: Pushing CI fix now. Will post confirmation when all jobs green.

Jorge Ramirez: Running final smoke now. Ping if anyone needs to test the sample token.

Ana Patel: Thanks everyone — I'll post release checklist summary and owner assignments after lunch. Keep pings short in this thread to avoid noise.
